title: 2+1D Spinless wallpaper groups: all allowed n0, e0=0
scope: The uniform E8 response is fixed to e0=0. All symmetry-allowed uniform IQH responses are included. The four data columns are final filtration groups after incoming identifications; their product need not be the final stacking group.
